tagline.id: Printer 3D makanan dengan tiga spuit yang bermuara ke satu nozel, untuk mencetak produk berlapis seperti analog daging.
tagline.en: A food 3D printer with three syringes feeding one nozzle, for printing layered products like meat analogs.

problem.id: Printer makanan multi-material biasanya pakai beberapa nozel terpisah yang rumit, atau satu nozel dengan purge tower yang membuang bahan setiap ganti material. Untuk makanan, bahan yang terbuang itu mahal dan sayang.
problem.en: Multi-material food printers usually rely on several separate nozzles, which adds complexity, or on one nozzle with a purge tower that throws material away at every change. With food, that wasted material is costly.

approach.id: Tiga spuit digerakkan motor masing-masing secara independen, lalu jalurnya disatukan sebelum nozel tunggal. Perpindahan antar material diatur lewat firmware, jadi tidak perlu purge tower dan bahan tidak terbuang. Salah satu aplikasinya: mencetak analog daging dengan bahan lemak, protein, dan serat untuk meniru serat otot dan marbling.
approach.en: Three syringes are each driven by their own motor, and their paths merge before a single nozzle. Material changes are handled in firmware, so there is no purge tower and no wasted food. One target application: printing meat analogs from fat, protein, and fiber materials to mimic muscle fiber and marbling.
